studiesPage.title: Competitor Analysis
studiesPage.subtitle: Track what your competitors are doing, what it means for your business, and what to do about it. Separate from sentiment and opinion tracking, which answers what people are saying.
studiesPage.noMatchBody: Try adjusting your search, status, or date filters.
studiesPage.emptyBody: Start one and Strata will read your website to work out your market, find who you compete with, and report what they are doing about it.

onboarding.title: New competitor study
onboarding.subtitle: Name the companies this study tracks — import a list or add them one at a time — then decide which ones get a report. Documents are optional and can be added now or later; approving the articles split out of them is what gives a tracked competitor evidence to report on.

step1.heading: Add your competitors
step1.hint: Import the tracked-competitors list exported from the scraper app, or add companies by hand. You can add more of either later from the workspace.
step1.emptyBody: Import a list or add one above to get started.

step2.heading: Review & track
step2.hint: Only tracked competitors get a report. Untrack anything you added but don’t want to follow, or remove it outright.
step2.emptyBody: Go back and import a list or add one by hand.

step3.heading: Add documents
step3.hint: Upload files to give your tracked competitors something to be reported on. Each one is extracted as soon as it uploads — text where the file has any, OCR where it doesn’t — split into candidate articles below, and approved automatically. Skip this and add documents later from the workspace if you’d rather do that first.
step3.emptyBody: Add some above, or finish now and add them later from the workspace.

documentsPanel.dropzoneTitle: Drag files here, or click to browse
documentsPanel.dropzoneHint: Multiple files at once are fine
documentsPanel.jsonHint: JSON/JSONL exports are read as articles directly — one record per article, no splitting.
documentsPanel.emptyBodyWizard: Add some above, or finish now and add them later from the workspace.
documentsPanel.emptyBodyStandalone: Add some above to give this study evidence to report on.

documents.pageHint: Upload files to give this study evidence to report on. Each one is extracted as soon as it uploads — text where the file has any, OCR where it doesn’t — split into candidate articles, and approved automatically so they’re usable evidence right away. Don’t want one included? Reject it here, or delete it from the Articles page later.

workspace.measuredAgainstSuffix: . Each card is one competitor: what they are doing, what it means for you, and what to do about it.
workspace.noProfileHint: Add your business profile so competitor activity can be judged against it.
workspace.noMatchBody: Try adjusting your search, impact, or date filters.
workspace.emptyTrackedBody: Competitors are tracked but nothing has been analysed yet. Run the analysis over the evidence on file.
workspace.emptyNoCompetitorsBody: No competitors are tracked yet. Head to the Competitors page to re-read documents and find the companies they are about.

competitorsPage.subtitle: Named from this study’s approved document articles. Only tracked competitors get a report; untrack anything the documents mention but you aren’t watching.
